label: RUCKUS ICX 8200-48PF (48x 1G PoE+, 740 W, 4x 25G SFP28)
description: RUCKUS ICX 8200-48PF stackable PoE access switch: 48x 10/100/1000BASE-T RJ-45 802.3af/at PoE+ (740 W budget), 4x 1/10/25G SFP28 uplink/stacking cages, 296 Gbps switching capacity.

poe.note: 740 W across 48 PoE+ downlinks: data sheet maximums 48 ports at 15.4 W (Class 3) or 24 ports at 30 W (Class 4). FastIron 10.0.20 PoE matrix: 2-pair ports 1-24 at 30 W, 802.3bt Type-3 up to Class 4.

fabric.note: Vendor figure 296 Gbps (data rate, full duplex); forwarding capacity 220 Mpps.

notes: 740 W on 48 PoE+ ports: all 48 at 15.4 W, or 24 at 30 W. Fixed power supply and fans - the redundant hot-swap chassis in this family are the 48PF2 and the PoE++ multigigabit pair (24XP2, 48NP2). PoE matrix: https://docs.ruckusnetworks.com/prod/ruckus-docs/fastiron-10020-managementguide/$/PoESupportMatrixGUID-5F3A189B-9A72-418A-AEA6-96FDC67978333en-US. Chassis: single integrated power supply and fans (no redundant PSU), one RJ-45 Ethernet out-of-band management port, one RJ-45 serial console port and one USB Type-C console port, one USB port for external storage. Serial console is fixed at 9600 baud, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, no flow control; the RJ-45 pinout is pin 3 TXD, pin 6 RXD, pin 4 ground. Boot firmware: 16 MB SPI flash holding two boot images (dual boot), 4 GB DDR4 main memory, 8 GB eMMC NAND. Stacking: up to 12 switches per stack over the SFP28 uplinks (1.2 Tbps aggregate stacking bandwidth; 10 km maximum stacking distance). Layer 3: static routing and RIP in the base image; OSPF, VRRP, VRF, GRE, PIM, PBR, BGP and VXLAN need the ICX8200-PREM-LIC premium licence, so this is modelled as l3-forward with no licence claim. Management: RUCKUS One, SmartZone, or controllerless Unleashed; the box also carries a CLI. Software: FastIron 10.0.20 is the train the ICX 8200 documentation set is published against (FastIron Management Configuration Guide 10.0.20). Sources: ICX 8200 data sheet (PA-117001.3-EN) https://www.ruckusnetworks.com/globalassets/digizuite/993200-RUCKUS-ICX-8200-Switch-Data-Sheet.pdf; ICX 8200 Technical Specifications, part 53-1005761-03, 15 October 2024 https://docs.ruckusnetworks.com/prod/ruckus-pdfs/icx8200-technicalspecification; product page https://www.ruckusnetworks.com/products/ethernet-switches/itemicx8200-48pf/.
